meaning: The productivity module chain on one copy of six (productivity-chain-clock-fixtures.ts); the disturbances are the coal cut (its feeder off, the belt emptied), the output loader removed, the iron foundries stopped (their waiting plates taken). `native` is the run under the game tests' protocol, timed in game ticks (tests/game/helpers/lua/steady.lua), recorded in Factorio 2.1.24: steady state (the machines making the target have made it over the trailing 3,600 ticks, no less than a window of whole clock cycles earlier), a baseline judged over its whole clock cycles (3,600 ticks unless the fixture names a longer one), then each disturbance until the output falls below the baseline's lowest minute, released and recovered. `generation` is the selection the family's generation test pins, with the sha256 of its exported clock's identity (`clockIdentity`); `recorded` is the recording that is current.

recorded.note: recorded under the protocol in game ticks before the PR was opened; pr is set when it is
